title: The Maximum load for the cart
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：maximum　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 maximum 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the gardener wrote of ① a maximum load for the cart in the notebook, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② so maximum that nobody in the garden would go near it. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the gardener, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the maximum ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the maximum load for the cart that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook for April 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too maximum to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the maximum ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a maximum speed on the road, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as maximum as the speed on the road they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was maximum or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something maximum, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite maximum; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the maximum ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, at once, she wrote of another maximum load for the cart in the same notebook, and the work, which took two springs, seemed ⑨ no less maximum than anybody had expected. ⑩ The maximum speed on the road that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the maximum ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 最大（前置定语 a maximum load for the cart：1986 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的那件最大的载重）
B. adj. 最大／最高（两处加强说法：so maximum that … 与 no less maximum than …）
C. adj. 最大／最高（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 最大（表语 too maximum to do：母亲觉得它太最大，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 最高（前置定语 a maximum speed on the road：叔叔把整件事称作一桩最高的限速）
F. adj. 最高（同级比较 as maximum as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩路上的最高限速相比）
G. adj. 最高（后置定语 something maximum：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 最高（受程度副词修饰 quite maximum：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a maximum load for the cart
the maximum load for the cart that
a maximum speed on the road
The maximum speed on the road that

answers.why: maximum 意为“最大”，1986 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的是“一件最大的载重”，此处作前置定语 a maximum load for the cart。
maximum 意为“最大”，此处用 so maximum that 结构，说它最大到园子里没人敢靠近。
maximum 意为“最大”，园艺笔记上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的最大车子的最大载重，等于最高级的说法。
maximum 意为“最大”，母亲认为这件东西“太最大了，谁也用不上”，too maximum to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
maximum 意为“最高”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩最高的限速”，此处作前置定语 a maximum speed on the road。
maximum 意为“最高”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩路上的最高限速一样最高”，同级比较用 as maximum as。
maximum 意为“最高”，园艺笔记上那半行字要的是“最高的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something maximum。
maximum 意为“最高”，邻园子来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当最高”，quite 修饰原级 maximum。
maximum 意为“最高”，no less maximum than 表示“其最高不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之最高不亚于任何人的预料。
maximum 意为“最高”，母亲 1998 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的最高限速”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，园丁在园艺笔记里记下了一件最大的载重。（a maximum load for the cart）
它最大到园子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so maximum that …）
母亲觉得它太最大，谁也用不上。（too maximum to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩最高的限速。（a maximum speed on the road）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩路上的最高限速一样最高。（as maximum as …）
到了 1993 年，园艺笔记上只剩半行字：要的是一件最高的东西。（something maximum）
answers: In 1986 the gardener wrote of a maximum load for the cart in the notebook.
It was so maximum that nobody in the garden would go near it.
My mother thought it too maximum to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a maximum speed on the road.
He said nobody would call it as maximum as the speed on the road they had once had.
By 1993 the notebook asked for nothing but something maximum.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 maximum 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the gardener wrote of a maximum load for the cart in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the maximum load for the cart that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too maximum to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a maximum speed on the road, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next garden called the plan quite maximum, and everybody laughed.
The maximum ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
